<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nKeelwater's claims-handling software enforces a single method for routing claims. This does not match the operational needs of insurance teams, who require different routing approaches: high-volume motor teams need automatic assignment based on postcode and workload for efficiency, while commercial, specialty, and marine teams need manual control to properly manage complex cases. The current system slows down efficient work and misallocates complex claims, hurting resolution quality and team productivity.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Motor insurance teams** who require automatic claim routing based on postcode and workload to handle high-volume cases efficiently [i:0be083b63305da63] [i:63e7d0c8fea46281] [i:9bcfbf187a659dd5].\n- **Commercial, specialty, and marine insurance teams** who need manual claim routing to manage complex cases involving multiple suppliers and policyholders [i:335a45d6e8f1c018] [i:49e903683f464d34] [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12].\n- **Accounts with both motor and commercial/specialty lines**, where the single routing method forces a compromise that fails to serve either team optimally [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6] [i:9179fd051ca6a5f8] [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n\n## Evidence\n- **Customer Feedback**: 6 accounts have raised this issue, generating 13 mentions [i:0be083b63305da63] [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6] [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12].\n- **Support Channel**: The support route accounts for 9 of the 13 mentions, indicating this is an active, post-sales problem affecting daily operations [i:0be083b63305da63] [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6] [i:335a45d6e8f1c018].\n- **Onboarding Channel**: The onboarding route accounts for 4 of the 13 mentions, showing the issue is also a barrier to successful implementation and adoption [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:63e7d0c8fea46281] [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].\n- **Financial Impact**: The 6 affected accounts represent a combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of 6430000.0 GBP [i:0be083b63305da63] [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6] [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12].\n- **Renewal Risk**: 1 renewal is scheduled within the next 90 days (as of 2026-10-01), specifically Marrowgate Commercial on 2026-12-12 [i:335a45d6e8f1c018] [i:49e903683f464d34].\n\n## Why now\n- **Immediate Operational Friction**: Customers are actively reporting that the current system is slowing down their motor teams and breaking their complex commercial cases, indicating the problem is impacting current productivity [i:0be083b63305da63] [i:49e903683f464d34] [i:63e7d0c8fea46281].\n- **Upcoming Renewal**: One affected account, Marrowgate Commercial, representing 1600000.0 GBP in ARR, is due for renewal on 2026-12-12, making this a timely concern for customer retention [i:335a45d6e8f1c018] [i:49e903683f464d34].\n- **Clear Customer Demand**: Feedback from multiple high-value accounts consistently calls for a per-team configuration for routing, demonstrating a unified and specific need across different customer segments [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6] [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:c8869934e9e77aad].\n- **Competitive Threat**: The inability to configure routing per team is cited as a reason one-size-fits-all doesn't work, suggesting customers may seek alternatives that offer this flexibility [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12] [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].",

<task>

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the headline figures against the fact sheet: 6 accounts, 13 mentions, 9 support and 4 onboarding mentions, 6,430,000 GBP combined ARR, and the single renewal within 90 days (Marrowgate Commercial, 2026-12-12) all match exactly. The per-team routing claims (motor wanting postcode/workload-based auto-assignment; commercial/specialty/marine wanting manual control for complex cases with multiple suppliers and policyholders) are each directly supported by the cited quotes, e.g. 49e903683f464d34 for the supplier/policyholder detail and 2b8201db7ce2cec6/63e7d0c8fea46281/c8869934e9e77aad for per-team configuration demand. No overstated claims, paraphrases in quotation marks, or contrary citations were found; all cited insight IDs exist and align with the statements they support.", "verdict": "pass"}
